S0_clean_selection_both_directions.evidence: 289-probe three-way A/B (candidate vs 52e830f vs d724d8c), harness qa/verification/scratch/v17b_s0.mjs + v17b_s0b.mjs. (a) MIS-BIND: ZERO replies bind under the candidate that dead-ended on either prior commit — the clean-selection rule is STRICTLY tighter (no negator word from the retired NEGATED_MENTION list is in SELECTION_FILLER, so every old dead-end survives). 30 residual mis-binds remain, ALL identical at 52e830f and d724d8c (pre-existing, not introduced): 18 cross-verb redirections + 12 entity-noun target flips. End-to-end through the REAL matcher+commandContradictsActionType+resolveClarificationField: 'reject bob smith' ARMS endEmploymentPersonIds, 'rename/assign/approve/reject/activate acme' ARM archiveCompanyIds. NEW DEFECT D127: 'activate' is in SELECTION_FILLER but absent from RESTORE_VERB_PATTERN (which has only 'reactivate'), so a make-active intent arms archive. Also: the code comment claims filler is 'the pending action's own verbs' but the set is a static union of ALL lifecycle verbs, independent of the pending action. (b) OVER-REFUSAL: 78-reply realistic corpus, candidate binds 57/78 vs 78/78 on BOTH priors; 21 legitimate naming replies newly dead-end (contractions/possessives, adverbs now/today/just/only/definitely, and ALL digit forms). Sharpest seam: D95 renders options as '(option 1)' but 'acme (option 1)', 'option 1, acme', 'acme #1' all dead-end because no digit is in the filler set while the words 'option' and 'number' are — dead weight in the allowlist. Dead-ends fall through to the LLM path so no founder is blocked; classified acceptable-but-notable (P3 usability).

S3_S7_completion_belt.evidence: Harnesses qa/verification/scratch/v17b_s3.mjs + v17b_s3b.mjs, three-way A/B. FALSE-NEGATIVE direction: candidate 0/30 false negatives vs 52e830f 15/30 and d724d8c 3/30 — D125 genuinely closes every fabrication shape #16 recorded, including all four disclosed ones. FALSE-POSITIVE direction: candidate 6/39 on the mixed corpus and 97/130 (75 percent) on a realistic corpus of truthful negatives about entities whose real names contain and/but/without/dash/parentheses, vs 0/130 on 52e830f. Boundary attribution: and 50/60, without 15/18, but 10/18, dash 10/12, paren 10/12, prose 2/10 (colon in a time '14:30', parenthetical 'No entity (including ACME) was archived'). Root cause: the new boundaries are not clause boundaries when they occur INSIDE A NOUN PHRASE, so the negator is severed from the completion verb it scopes over: 'No company named Salt and Pepper Co was archived' splits to ['No company named Salt','Pepper Co was archived'] and the second fragment matches LEGACY_PAST_COMPLETION with no negator. Downstream: readsAsCompletion feeds BOTH arms — legacyProseFallback (index.ts:5583 replaces the whole truthful answer with 'I can t actually do that from chat — nothing was changed') and structuredProseDrift -> rewriteFromStructure (index.ts:5466 discards the prose). This is the exact class index.ts:5362 itself records as WORSE than the fabrication the belt exists to catch (run14/D112, ledger #4905), recurring for the sixth consecutive drift-belt change. The candidate's own disclosed residual ('a negator inside one bare clause with no separator at all') does not mention this direction at all.
